responses.question: Is buyback sustainability intact if trailing FCF/share approaches the $18 falsifier while debt stays elevated?
responses.answer: Partially answered from filings: FY2025 FCF $9.85B, buybacks $11.28B, cash ~$5.4B, long-term debt ~$6.2B after 2025 notes. Sustainability under an $18 FCF/share path is a stress case, not a filing fact; unresolved as a forward capital-allocation judgment.
